messages:
alex-peopleops: Morning all — quick checklist for Devon's first day (Mon). Need I-9 done, background check kicked off, laptop shipping/pickup, and orientation slot confirmed.

maria-hr: @devon welcome! I sent the hire packet and a BambooHR invite. For I-9 you can bring ONE valid passport OR driver’s license + social security card. Remote? We have authorized agent flow.

sam-it: @devon If you're on-site, laptop & peripherals will be at 2nd-floor kitting desk by 8:30am. Remote folks: we ship next-business-day after you confirm address. Shipping is signature required.

devon-newhire: Thanks — I'm remote in SF. Shipping address is 123 Market St Apt 5B, San Francisco CA 94103. Also what's the orientation cadence / Zoom link?

alex-peopleops: Got address @devon. Orientation: 9:00am PT on day 1 (60m). Agenda: HR welcome, security + compliance, IT setup, meet your buddy. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/onboard/1759031120

onboarding-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: Please complete preboarding tasks:
- I-9 (if remote, use authorized agent link) https://kiosk.redwood.com/i9/1759031120
- Background check: https://vendor-check.example/abc123 (complete within 48h)

maria-hr: FYI for I-9 docs we accept: passport OR (state ID + SS card). If you only have a digital photo of a document, bring the physical copy on day 1. DM me if you need an exception.

sam-it: @alex-peopleops I'll pre-stage Okta and add Devon to `eng-new-hires`. I'll also pre-create access requests for GitHub and JIRA — manager can approve on day-1.

alex-peopleops: Thanks @sam-it — please add `team/quickstart` and `infra/internal-tools` repos by default. Manager will request extras.

devon-newhire: Quick Q: background checks — how long do they usually take?

maria-hr: Typically 24–72 hours. If anything flags we'll reach out and explain next steps. No SSN required on forms here in thread — you'll provide during vendor flow.

sam-it: Shipping note: we use ShipIt portal (https://shipit.redwood.dev). If shipping, expect tracking email once dispatched. If you need expedited, tell me now.

devon-newhire: I completed the background vendor consent just now. Also I've filled the BambooHR W-4 and direct deposit forms.

alex-peopleops: Perfect. Quick checklist for visibility (mark with :white_check_mark: once done):
- I-9 completed
- Background check started/completed
- Laptop shipped / picked up
- Orientation attended (9am PT day-1)
- W-4 + bank info in BambooHR
- Security training in LMS (complete within 3 business days)

onboarding-bot: Reminder set: 24h follow-up for outstanding preboarding tasks.

maria-hr: @devon once background returns clear we'll trigger badge provisioning. If you need a temporary virtual badge for Zoom-only access, say so.

devon-newhire: Thanks everyone — I'll ping here when I get the shipping/tracking and when I finish the I-9. :pray:

alex-peopleops: Great — see you Monday! :wave:
